sources.title: Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Belt site package
sources.usage: Project scope, allowed design space, enums, planning limits and schemas.
sources.limitation: The package does not contain official precise overall or key-area polygons.

sources.title: Repository source registry
sources.usage: Controls formal-ready, background-only and provisional-only uses.
sources.limitation: A registry is not a substitute for the underlying source.

sources.title: Agent fact-pack navigation layer
sources.usage: Navigation for scopes, tasks and missing-data checks.

sources.title: Organizer-supplied provisional boundaries
sources.usage: Temporary constraint for geometry generation and recalculation.
sources.limitation: Not an official boundary, parcel line, road redline, heritage line or approval basis.

sources.title: Organizer-supplied provisional key-area polygons
sources.usage: Temporary location of the three mandatory detailed-design areas.
sources.limitation: Rectangular edges must not be read as cadastral, street or statutory boundaries.

sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.usage: Official project scope, objectives, required tasks and design-depth context.

sources.title: Urban-design AI open-call taskbook
sources.usage: Six agent tasks, identity, cases, scenarios, personas, landmarks, culture and operations.
sources.limitation: Agent prompts are not statutory planning controls.

sources.title: C2PA Content Credentials Technical Specification 2.4
sources.publisher: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for opt-in media provenance and transformation history.
sources.limitation: Provenance does not itself judge truth, quality or permission.

sources.title: 人工智能生成合成内容标识办法发布说明
sources.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室
sources.usage: Primary reference for explicit and implicit labels on AI-generated or synthetic content.
sources.limitation: The proposal is a spatial concept and does not claim regulatory compliance certification.

sources.title: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
sources.usage: Regulatory context for public-facing generative-AI services and legitimate rights.
sources.limitation: Professional legal review remains required for any implementation.

sources.title: City of Helsinki AI Register
sources.usage: Case mechanism for readable public descriptions and feedback on city AI systems.
sources.limitation: No Finnish institutional authority or system facts are transferred to Beijing.

sources.title: Algorithm Register of the Dutch government
sources.usage: Case mechanism for common, publicly readable algorithm records.
sources.limitation: The proposal source note is not a government registration or approval.

sources.title: Algorithmic Transparency Standard
sources.usage: Case mechanism for interoperable, open, city-level algorithm descriptions.
sources.limitation: Only the idea of consistent fields is translated; governance arrangements are not copied.

sources.title: Europeana Rights Statements FAQ
sources.usage: Case mechanism for communicating copyright status and reuse conditions of digital heritage objects.
sources.limitation: No Europeana object or licence is imported into the proposal.

sources.title: Mozilla Common Voice Legal Terms
sources.usage: Case mechanism for contributor assurances, dataset licensing and safeguards around voice contribution.
sources.limitation: Local oral-history consent must be separately designed and professionally reviewed.

sources.title: Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
sources.usage: Case reference for traceability, cultural diversity, public literacy, accessibility and participation.
sources.limitation: The recommendation is a normative reference, not a project approval or local performance claim.
